page.layout: One page of running text, full width. Running head with page number at top right. Heading in capitals below the text, then one paragraph of text. Signature at the foot left and catchword at the foot right.

main_text.p: tores à Quæstore censuum, monasticorum, uti est decreto Ordinum statutum; de qua quotannis mense Februario in Camera rationum præsentibus Ordinum delectis calculum ponere coguntur. Voluntatem horum exactor exequitur: & rationes menstruas de iis, quæ ejus curæ commissa sunt, apud hos eosdem reddit. Et licet etiam curatoribus adscisceré sibi matronas duas honestas rei œconomicæ peritas, quæ partem curarum & inspectionis in se recipiant, sed gratuitò similiter, ut ipsi curatores. Hoc ἐγκρα-τεῖον[?] multis malis terrori, multis etiam emendationi est, à disciplina & coërcitione nuncupatum.
main_text.head: DE ACADEMIA GRONINGÆ NUPER INSTITUTA.
main_text.p: CORONIS mihi esto hujus li-belli recogniti Academia in hac urbe ab Ordinibus provinciæ stu-dio procerum eruditorum anno superiore M. DC. XIV instituta, & solen-

page.notes: The initial C of "Coronis" is a large woodcut initial, joined to the following word as "CORONIS". The Greek word after "Hoc" is hyphenated across the line end and is hard to read; the reading ἐγκρα-τεῖον is a best guess and is marked [?]. The faint "Digitized by Google" mark at the lower right is not transcribed.
